name: Text to Sound Studio
summary: Prompt-first sound generation: select model and settings, start a new run directly from the View and play every generated WAV.
help: Use in the Text to Sound Generation project. Wire the sound generator's WAV output to the sounds input. Generate starts a flow run with per-run settings sent to the generator node named generate. Shows independent players for each completed WAV, a download link, and run status. Requires run permission.
